'''Olun Kallea''' was the father of [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] and the husband of [[Henne Kallea]]. He was a member of [[House Kallea]] on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. He and Henne wished their daughter Freia to marry into a higher ranked house, though she had planned to apprentice in the [[Brentaal Spacefarers League]] to both their disapproval.<ref name="EA" />
